pages.title: Electromagnetic Rail
pages.text: AeroIE does not add conventional multiblock machines, but it does allow different peripherals to link together.$(br2)An Electromagnetic Rail can launch a subspace or accelerate a shell to form a powerful railgun.$(br2)The following pages explain how to construct a working rail.

1. Place an Electromagnetic Rail Core on a subspace with its port—the blue-gray textured face—pointing along the intended direction of the rail.$(br2)2. Right-click the core to open its GUI and insert at least as many Electromagnetic Rail blocks as the desired rail length. The maximum is 4*64=256.$(br2)3. Place an Electromagnetic Rail Top directly ahead of the core at the desired distance, with its opening facing along the rail's direction.

4. Click the structure-check button in the Electromagnetic Rail Core. If the structure is valid, a green success message appears and the rail is automatically formed between the core and its top. If it fails, a red message explains why.$(br2)5. An Electromagnetic Rail Cannon can be mounted on the port face of a completed core and aimed along the rail. It fires electromagnetically accelerated armor-piercing shells whose penetration increases with the completed rail's length.
